recommendations: Replace the hardcoded streaming feed with a bounded Supply Graph Snapshot that shows verified active looks, fit notes, and local payment coverage, accompanied by an explicit as‑of date and a clear link to explore verified collections.

Display a small set of Featured Verified Collections with curator identities and collection-level verification (limit to 3 cards at launch), each card showing curator name, culture/category, stock/purchase status, and a direct link to the collection.

Publish a concise Recently Strengthened supply-graph log (3 cards max) that highlights real milestones (e.g., new curator verifications, new payment rails, updated fit standards) with dates and source links, avoiding any real‑time ticker.

Provide Buyer-Ready by Market as an architectural proof: show how humans and agents resolve against the same inventory graph, including stock status, market availability, and local payment rails, with a simple status legend (Available, In verification, Pilot, Planned) and a link to the underlying details.

Conclude with Founding Curator & Agent Access: two invitation panels (Curator and Agent) that state gating criteria, review cadence, and next steps, avoiding any public waitlist counts and explaining what happens after submission.
